items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass.

items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 10.0) flaw allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, fixed in APSB26-153 but requiring a manual patch for new installations.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 10.0) zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, actively exploited in the wild, for which Adobe released an emergency hotfix.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 9.1) incorrect authorization flaw allowing unauthenticated customer account takeover and privilege escalation, added to CISA KEV due to active exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: A high severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A high severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.
